model: sincere plurality across three mutually exclusive treasury proposals

parameters.valuation_distribution: independent uniform [0, 1) per actor and proposal

metric_definitions.holder_efficiency: mean over profiles of winning total actor valuation / maximal total actor valuation
metric_definitions.stake_efficiency: mean over profiles of winning token-share-weighted valuation / maximal token-share-weighted valuation
metric_definitions.whale_success: fraction of profiles where winner is whale's top-valued proposal
metric_definitions.nonwhale_representation: fraction where winner maximizes seven ordinary holders' combined valuation

observation: SRV with eight equal whale wallets yields whale voting power above all ordinary holders combined; TWV and split SRV choose the whale's sincere first choice on every paired profile.
